name: vestn-daily-intel-brief
purpose: Poll watch-list sources each morning, filter and dedupe against prior briefs, draft the daily brief, flag items for CJ, write to the VvV vault.
step0_reason: Ownership ambiguity (two routines previously both flagged the same item) and provenance (every brief item cites its source) are central. Shared state exists in the dedupe memory.

nodes.does: Fires the routine at 06:30 UK each weekday.
Fetches new items from the watch list defined in vestn-intel-briefs. Deterministic, no model.
Drops items already covered in the last 14 briefs using URL and title hash. Owns the dedupe memory.
Scores each new item against the signal thresholds and assigns [SOCIAL], [DECK], or FLAG FOR CJ REVIEW tags.
Writes the brief in house format from scored items above threshold, citing source per item.
Independently checks every cited source exists in raw_items, no item is repeated from prior briefs, frontmatter is valid. Never sees the drafter's reasoning.
CJ reviews only items tagged FLAG FOR CJ REVIEW. Everything else passes on verifier acceptance.
Writes the brief to the VvV vault at the destination defined in vestn-intel-briefs. Reversible: a bad write is overwritten next run.

stop_rules.exit_condition: verify-brief accepts AND (no FLAG items OR cj-gate approves)

governance.who_moves_thresholds: CJ, via version bump on this spec

audit.gap: no quarterly cold read of briefs against what CJ actually acted on

changelog.change: Initial spec reconstructed from the routine prompt. Verifier added; previously the drafter self-checked.
Added the direct route from verify-brief to write-vault for briefs with nothing flagged. The gate description and the exit condition already assumed it and the edge was missing. Found in review.
